1. Dimerization mechanisms (M3): These would maintain linear [S] dependence since the rate-limiting step is catS→P+cat
2. Activation mechanisms (M6/M8): These would show similar [S] dependence to the first experiment but with altered catalyst efficiency
3. CatS2 mechanisms (M7): These would show reduced reaction rates due to the need for two substrate molecules to form catS2
The design isolates substrate dependency while maintaining product inhibition conditions, creating a sensitive test for mechanistic differences in binding requirements.
